reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses the matcher's getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the single and ranged cases now share one inversion step and call sites only pass their operator.

placement.why: The expected-amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the one definition server and client already use.

scope.why: Focused on the planning/expectation paths (display-only cells untouched); turning the inverse boolean into an options object is a small, justified signature change that adds test churn.

maintainability.why: A named-options signature reads well and one function owns the rule; an optional op still lets a future caller silently get the exact amount for an approximate schedule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every expected-amount path routes through getScheduledAmount with its operator.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; posting, preview, forecast, template, updateActions, API model and account balance all pass the operator to it.
